description: How the cheapest rental price of one GPU class has moved: one point per day since 1 November 2026 (snapshots are hourly from 10 November; earlier days have only a few), or one per hour for the last three days. For each point: the cheapest on-demand price seen, the typical cheapest (median across the day's hourly snapshots) and the cheapest cloud spot price, per GPU. Use it to judge whether a price is unusually low or high before renting, or how much waiting could save.

days.description: How far back, in days (hourly: at most 3)

gpu_class.description: GPU model, as for find_offers: RTX4090, H100, A100_80, L4 ...

name: price_history

series.description: One entry per matching class (H100 matches the SXM, PCIe and NVL variants)

hours_observed.description: Daily only: hourly snapshots that day, 24 when complete

typical_on_demand.description: Daily only: median of the hourly cheapest prices

summary.description: Over the returned points, on the on-demand price where there is one, else spot

title: GPU price history
